name: Amaenbo Shimai no Omutsu Heya
original_name: あまえんぼ姉妹のおむつ部屋
source:
The protagonist, looking for a job, comes across a nondescript-looking apartment, with a note on the door saying "Please take care of the girls."

When he comes in, he finds two cute, childish girls in need of an "Onii-chan" to tend to their various needs.

And thus, he begins a new life as a full-time babysitter for the energetic Chika and shy Misato.
translation:
主人公正在找工作时，发现一栋外表毫不起眼的公寓，门上贴着一张字条：“请照顾这些女孩。”

他走进房间后，见到了两名可爱又孩子气的少女。她们需要一位“哥哥”照料生活中的各种需求。

于是，主人公开始了担任全职保姆的新生活，照顾活泼好动的千花与害羞的美里。
